properties.NAME: BEXAR (Tex.)
properties.CHANGE: BEXAR (Tex.) boundaries defined to cover all non-county area in the Rep. of Texas, included the panhandle of present Okla. and overlapped part of Indian Terr. 2 changes in BEXAR bet. 19 Dec. 1836 and 27 Nov 1839 did not effect Okla. and are not mapped.
